Knit-print method for apa_table_spec (displays the table in a Quarto chunk)

Source: R/quarto.R
knit_print.apa_table_spec.Rd

Called automatically by knitr when an `apa_table_spec` object is returned from a chunk. Delegates to the same rendering apa.quarto.pdf / apa.quarto.docx / apa.quarto.html share, so a bare `table1` on its own line in a chunk takes exactly the same path as the explicit call the template writes – including the automatic rotated page for a table too wide to stand upright. "Rendering" the document turns it into the finished Word, PDF, or HTML file; this method supplies the table's contribution to that finished file. There is no function name here for a name/target mismatch message to name (D30's guidance is a property of the three named entry points, not of this automatic path), so none is ever printed for a bare table.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'apa_table_spec'
knit_print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An `apa_table_spec` object.

...

Additional arguments passed on when the table is not going into a PDF.

Value

A knit_asis object.
